question: What was the revenue from orders purchased in Q4 2017 (October through December)?
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT oi.price, oi.freight_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-10-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT SUM(price + freight_value) AS revenue_q4_2017 FROM delivered_orders
